text:
Liam: Quick check — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy today? Need CTA mapping, webinar tie-in, and a short benchmark blurb for the Hosted hero.
Marta: On it. Can we make the Hosted hero emphasis 'fastest path to prod' + a clear per-token cost line? Suggestion: 'Hosted API — Instant access to production-ready LLMs with predictable latency and transparent pricing.'
Ava: Love that. For Dedicated, highlight reserved capacity and SLA. Try: 'Dedicated — Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput and enterprise SLAs.'
Sam: Private should be security-first and concise: 'Private — VPC & on-prem options with KMS/HSM and audit logs.' Keep the header punchy.
Ravi: For CTAs: Hosted -> 'Try hosted API', Dedicated -> 'Contact sales about Reserved Capacity', Private -> 'Get a private demo'. Inbound routing: Hosted -> product sign-up funnel; Dedicated -> SDR queue (priority 2); Private -> AE + security SE (priority 1).
Liam: SG. Webinar tie-in idea: 'From prototype to production: choosing hosted, dedicated, or private' — live next Wed. Add as a secondary CTA under hero (small 'Join webinar'). Also use the webinar as a lead magnet for Dedicated/Private.
Ava: Benchmarks: we have a one-pager with p95 latencies and per-1k-token cost vs self-hosted. One-line for hero: 'Benchmarked: 2–3x lower per-token unit cost vs self-hosted for standard chat workloads.' Keep it conservative.
Marta: We should A/B test headline variants for Hosted: 'Start with Hosted' vs 'Fastest path to production' vs 'Production-ready hosted API'. Headlines under 8 words.
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll update the Figma hero components and CTA spacing. Quick Q — surface Optimize/quantization recommendations on pricing page or under Dedicated details?
Ravi: Put Optimize link on Dedicated details (with short explainer) and an anchor on pricing. Also add UTM param: ?utm_source=website&utm_campaign=deploy_mode&utm_medium=cta to all CTAs so we can route by campaign. I'll wire routing rules: Hosted leads -> product-qualified email flow; Dedicated -> SDR playbook named 'Reserved capacity inquiry'; Private -> AE immediate outreach with security SE cc.
LaunchBot: Reminder: webinar event created — https://events.redwood.ai/webinar-deploy-choices. Registration open. Speakers: Marta, Ravi, Nina (Lead Eng).
Liam: Perfect. Next steps: @Sam update Figma + hero CTAs; @Marta write three 10-word headline options for each mode; @Ava draft the benchmark one-liner and link to one-pager; @Ravi configure routing and UTMs. Ping this thread when done. Thanks!
